hypothesis: In five historical outer training-fold replays, three distinct seeds of the already-selected estimators improved the original expanded prediction by 5,4,7,7,3 correct respectively. Requiring a positive accuracy change on three small inner panels rejected all five. Test a new deployable decision policy prospectively, keeping the original result deployable throughout.
policy: The unified entry first completes its ordinary autonomous method search and full refit. Given a reported ceiling above 16, the opt-in policy may spend idle resources only on stochastic, single-fit members of the actually selected solution. Require training evidence on at least two matching held partitions and available probabilities. On the latest applicable confirmation split, run one independently seeded repeat for each supported member. Test the blended probability predictions on that training-only split. Demand measurable prediction diversity and no detectable deterioration in either declared primary metric or multiclass Brier loss at a one-sided 1.64 paired standard-error tolerance; use group-block jackknife with deterministic groups. Only when supported run two extra full-data seeds per eligible selected member. Average within member, keeping weight between originally selected members unchanged. On insufficient evidence/resources, restrictions, or a failed new worker, retain the already exported base selection. No task names, manually chosen finalist, or extra API call.
experiment: Use a new stratified exact-feature-group five-fold split of the complete original 8,117 training rows, using seed label 'AIAA released training fresh seed policy qualification v1'. Anonymous folds 0,2,4. Cold solve the ordinary and new policy on exactly the same inputs, current frozen source and fit ceiling of 64 each including all refits, 1800 seconds. Check their early search trace matches and their exports can be reloaded in fresh processes. Lock all six predictions before external scoring. Some of these training rows were reused during earlier research.
designated_gate: Requires at least two positive outer folds, no outer regression worse than .003, and a pooled gain of .003 over the equal-budget ordinary entry. If it passes use the identical source, seed policy and 64 budget on the raw course training package to predict designated validation features and grade once together with the previously sealed local ten-fit anchor. The earlier unconditional diagnostic never qualifies a different policy by itself. Keep official test and H2 sealed.
